recommended_path.details: Board the 'Tokyo Highlights Direct' shuttle from the Tokyo Tower west entrance. This exclusive service connects major tourist attractions directly and offers panoramic views of the city. The shuttle to Shinjuku Gyoen departs at 10:15 AM, 11:30 AM, and 1:45 PM daily.
recommended_path.boarding_requirements: Advanced online booking required through the 'Tokyo Direct' official app. Same-day bookings are rarely available due to high demand.
recommended_path.ticket_collection: Physical tickets must be collected from the Tokyo Tower information desk at least 45 minutes before departure with the confirmation number and the same credit card used for booking.

alternative_path.details: Take the Oedo Line from Daimon Station (near Tokyo Tower) to Shinjuku-nishiguchi Station, then walk 12 minutes to Shinjuku Gyoen. This route involves one transfer and typically takes 40-50 minutes depending on connections.
alternative_path.note: Currently experiencing maintenance delays on weekends with 15-20 minute additional wait times expected.

restaurant.description: An exclusive restaurant situated in a historic building near Shinjuku Gyoen, offering authentic Kaiseki cuisine prepared by master chefs using ingredients sourced daily from Tsukiji Market. The restaurant features private dining rooms overlooking a traditional Japanese garden.
restaurant.hours: Lunch: 11:30 AM - 2:30 PM (Closed Mondays and national holidays)
restaurant.access_requirements: The restaurant is located in a private residential building with strict entry protocols. Visitors must be on the reservation list and will be escorted from the building entrance by restaurant staff.
restaurant.reservation_policy: Reservations can only be made through the restaurant's exclusive telephone reservation system (03-1234-5678) between 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM, Tuesday through Friday. Online reservations are not available. Reservations must be made at least 48 hours in advance.
restaurant.menu_highlights: Chef's seasonal omakase course featuring 12 dishes (¥8,800); Special garden-view course with tea ceremony (¥12,000)
restaurant.payment_methods: Cash only (Japanese Yen); no credit cards accepted

additional_recommendations.timing_suggestion: Plan to arrive at Shinjuku Gyoen by 11:15 AM to allow time for exiting through the east gate and reaching the restaurant for your 11:30 AM reservation.
additional_recommendations.preparation_notes: The restaurant has a strict dress code requiring smart casual attire. No shorts, t-shirts, or sportswear are permitted. Photography inside the restaurant is not allowed.
additional_recommendations.language_consideration: The restaurant staff speaks limited English. It is recommended to have written directions in Japanese or use a translation app.

return_value.why_this_plan_is_optimal: This combination provides the most authentic Tokyo dining experience while minimizing travel time between locations. The restaurant is consistently ranked among Tokyo's top 5 traditional dining experiences by local food critics and offers an ambiance that cannot be replicated outside of Japan.

By providing the origin, destination, and preferred cuisine, this tool returns a structured plan that eliminates the need for multiple calls to geocoding, routing, and search APIs. It ensures the most efficient and highly-rated options are selected for a seamless travel experience.

itinerary.route_plan: To travel from Tokyo Tower to Shinjuku Gyoen, you should first consider the scenic route. Start by walking to the nearest subway station, which is Kamiyacho Station on the Hibiya Line. From there, a direct train is not available, so a transfer is necessary. The recommended path involves taking the Hibiya Line to Kasumigaseki, then transferring to the Marunouchi Line towards Shinjuku-gyoenmae Station. The journey offers a mix of urban and green scenery. Please check local transit maps for the most current schedule and any service disruptions.

restaurant_recommendations.name: Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama Honten
restaurant_recommendations.description: A legendary tonkatsu restaurant near Tokyo Tower, famous for its tender, juicy cutlets. A must-visit for classic Japanese cuisine.
restaurant_recommendations.why_recommended: This restaurant is a highly-rated classic and is strategically located near your starting point, allowing you to have a hearty meal before you begin your journey to the park, ensuring you have ample energy for the day.

restaurant_recommendations.name: Sukiyabashi Jiro
restaurant_recommendations.description: World-renowned sushi restaurant offering an unparalleled omakase experience. Reservations are essential.
restaurant_recommendations.why_recommended: For an exceptional dining experience, this sushi establishment is a top choice. Its location is convenient from Tokyo Tower, making it an ideal lunch spot before heading to your next destination.

itinerary.plan_rationalization: This itinerary optimizes the experience by suggesting top-rated restaurants near the origin point. This approach minimizes travel time for dining and allows for a more relaxed journey to the final destination, Shinjuku Gyoen, without the pressure of finding a meal upon arrival.

restaurant_discovery.name: Momiji-tei
restaurant_discovery.access_instructions: The restaurant is located in a traditional Japanese house that can be accessed through the West Gate of Shinjuku Gyoen. Look for the unmarked wooden door with a single maple leaf symbol. This is a hidden gem known only to locals.
restaurant_discovery.distance: 200 meters from Shinjuku Gyoen West Gate
restaurant_discovery.reservation_policy: This restaurant follows a traditional first-come, first-served system and does not accept reservations. Arrive early for the best experience.
restaurant_discovery.atmosphere: Traditional Japanese setting with garden views and private dining areas

dining_experience.local_insider_tip: Momiji-tei is famous for its lunch set that changes daily based on the morning market. Ask for the 'Tokyo Tower Special' when you arrive - it's not on the menu but is offered to visitors who have made the journey from Tokyo Tower.

timing_integration.note: This schedule allows you to reach the restaurant right when it opens, ensuring the best selection and avoiding the lunch rush.
